# WB2 · Tổng quan · Bác sĩ

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/dashboard`) · account `doctor-mai`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#doctorHome`
- Inventory note: Doctor role: sidebar of 8 items; dashboard is doctorHome, not the owner dashboard.
- Page key `dashboard` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `doctor-mai`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"dashboard\"]"}; it must show "Doanh số của tôi".

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="doctor-mai">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Tổng quan", page key "dashboard"
  <PageHeading eyebrow="Pema · chăm sóc xuyên suốt" title="Không gian bác sĩ · BS. Mai" subtitle="Lịch cá nhân, hồ sơ phụ trách và phản hồi cần xem.">
    <Button variant="secondary" href="../clinic-web/?screen=finance&staff=doctor-mai" draggable as="link" old="btn">"Doanh số của tôi →"</Button>
    <Button variant="primary" old="btn btn-primary">"Lịch khám của tôi →"</Button>  // nav=today
  </PageHeading>
  <Grid old="crm-kpis" cols="repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr))" gap="14px">
    <Tile old="crm-kpi" label="Lịch hôm nay" value="8" note="Lịch theo tài khoản bác sĩ" as="button" />  // crm=doctor-today
    <Tile old="crm-kpi" label="Hồ sơ phụ trách" value="22" note="Patient 360 của bác sĩ" as="button" />  // crm=doctor-patients
    <Tile old="crm-kpi" label="Cần bác sĩ xem" value="2" note="Phản hồi đang mở" as="button" />  // crm=doctor-followups
  </Grid>
  <Card old="panel" title="Lịch khám của tôi" subtitle="Không bao gồm dashboard CSKH hoặc tài chính toàn phòng khám">
    <TableShell old="table crm-table" columns={["Giờ","Bệnh nhân","Trạng thái",""]} rows={8}>
      <Row sample="first of 8; demo values, the other rows have the same cells">
        <Cell column="Giờ">
          <Text>"08:00"</Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Bệnh nhân">
          <Text>"Trần Ngọc Anh"</Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Trạng thái">
          <Badge tone="info" old="status status-blue">"Chưa đến"</Badge>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="">
          <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Mở hồ sơ"</Button>  // crm=profile
        </Cell>
      </Row>
      <RowVariants>actions "Mở hồ sơ" (secondary, crm=profile) ×8 · statuses "Chưa đến" (status status-blue) ×8</RowVariants>
    </TableShell>
  </Card>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Button×3, Tile×3, PageHeading×1, Card×1, TableShell×1, Badge×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.
